policy.equations: Named equation/model entries, not scalar component equations or mathematically disjoint families. Includes frameworks and auxiliary formulations; variants share one entry except the three separately explained SR/GR fluid systems. Biological entries are imported once from their own catalog.
policy.methods: Named numerical methods and building blocks with a reading chapter. Aliases count once; RK stages, dimensions, parameter combinations, mesh layouts and theoretical conditions do not add methods. A family and a separately explained algorithm may both appear. Not a count of mutually exclusive end-to-end solvers.
policy.papers: Unique bibliographic publications classified as journal articles or conference papers, deduplicated by DOI or author/title/year. Includes reviews, translations and explicitly labeled accepted papers; not a claim that every full text was inspected. Books, chapters, reports, preprints and documentation are separate.
policy.references: Unique cataloged works across all publication types. An original publication and a later translation are separate works; duplicate DOI records are not. NASA case links in prose are not catalog records.
policy.test_problems: Count independent problems across published atlas results and the verified public code edition. Distinguish governing equations, dimensions, boundary conditions and named initial/source problems; merge solver, mesh, step-size, parameter-sweep, random-seed and presentation variants of the same problem. Repeated Sod exhibits, wedge Mach variants and CT/GLM variants do not add problems. Exclude reference-only evaluations, planned/literature-only entries, diagrams, and local identity/invariant/input-error unit checks. Static-force, boundary-value, approximation and algebraic problems are included; not every entry is a time-evolving simulation.

items.label: Linear advection
items.scope: Existing constant-speed transport plus a fixed periodic WENO cell-mean comparison; local reconstruction rates are not universal PDE rates.

items.label: Poisson / Laplace
items.scope: Additional cases cover an L-shaped singularity with matched-DOF grading,warped squares,pure-Neumann compatibility/mean gauge and mixed Robin conditions. Existing Poisson examples remain; distinguish residuals from continuous error.

items.label: Shallow water, including the rotating linear model
items.scope: Wet1D and linear rotating Fourier checks plus a genuine dry-bed Ritter example; bed sources are represented by a separate model.

items.label: Ideal MHD
items.scope: Retain existing MHD examples. Add a full-eight-state1D aligned CP wave and actual2D magnetic-loop/postshock Orszag–Tang cases. Independent Athena references for the latter two are finite-grid numerical solutions,not exact or generic validation.

items.label: Incompressible Navier–Stokes
items.scope: Scoped periodic MAC/Taylor–Green and nonperiodic Re100 vorticity-cavity examples; cavity pressure is not validated.

items.label: Gravitational particle model
items.scope: Static force evaluations and boundary kernels; no coupled self-gravitating fluid evolution.

items.label: Auxiliary hyperbolic diffusion system
items.scope: Periodic first-order steady-solution baseline, not physical-time heat diffusion.

items.label: Special-relativistic hydrodynamics
items.scope: Mild fixed symmetric two-shock1D collision with exact conserved cell means; not a generic relativistic Riemann or GR solver.

items.label: General-relativistic hydrodynamics
items.scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

items.label: Rotated-hybrid Riemann solver
items.scope: Explicit directional HLLE/Roe composition with unit-normal flux checks and conforming cylinder-forebody controls. Distinct from the optimized 2008 Rotated-RHLL formula; no universal carbuncle-free claim.

items.label: Scalar residual distribution

items.label: Legendre modal basis / orthonormal scaling

items.label: Lagrange nodal basis / GLL collocation

items.label: Limited PPM reconstruction
items.scope: Method-of-lines parabolic FV and a separate direct-Eulerian traced primitive PPM with contact steepening and shock flattening switches. No Lagrange/remap or multidimensional CTU.

items.label: Euler characteristic reconstruction
items.scope: Local conservative FV basis or face-frozen Roe FD basis; controlled component/characteristic comparisons.

items.label: AUSM-family flux splitting
items.scope: Arithmetic-sound-speed AUSM plus specified critical-sound-speed AUSM+ and AUSM+-up. Matched traced-PPM cases, a recorded strong-jump failure and forebody tests; no low-Mach PDE certification.

items.label: Logistic population growth
items.scope: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

items.label: Michaelis–Menten and full enzyme kinetics
items.scope: The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct.

items.label: McKendrick age-structured population
items.scope: This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance.

items.label: SIR and SEIR compartment models
items.scope: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

items.label: Fisher–KPP invasion front
items.scope: Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed.

items.label: Monod growth and chemostat
items.scope: This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model.

items.label: Hodgkin–Huxley membrane dynamics
items.scope: The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey.

items.label: Turing reaction–diffusion framework
items.scope: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

items.label: FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery
items.scope: Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

items.label: Keller–Segel chemotaxis
items.scope: This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics.

items.label: Gierer–Meinhardt activator–inhibitor
items.scope: Source densities, saturation and baseline production vary across the model family. This simplified formula is not a verbatim transcription of every original variant.

items.label: Fluid–elastic structure and immersed boundaries
items.scope: Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling.

items.label: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA
items.scope: The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation.

items.label: Mackey–Glass delayed physiological feedback
items.scope: A scalar initial value alone is insufficient. The delayed ODE is distinct from a spatial reaction–diffusion model.

items.label: Replicator evolutionary game dynamics
items.scope: No universal Lyapunov function or equivalence of fixed point and evolutionarily stable strategy is assumed.

items.label: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion
items.scope: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. items.label: Shigesada–Kawasaki–Teramoto cross-diffusion
items.scope: The displayed homogeneous-environment reduction omits the original environmental-potential terms. It is not equivalent to two independent scalar diffusion equations.

items.label: Gray–Scott spatial autocatalysis
items.scope: 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability.

items.label: Aliev–Panfilov cardiac excitation
items.scope: Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model.

items.label: Repressilator mRNA–protein network
items.scope: The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent.

items.label: Genetic toggle switch
items.scope: Bistability is not guaranteed for arbitrary Hill exponents or production rates. Induction, mRNA dynamics and noise are additional model choices.

items.label: Schrodinger eigenproblems
items.scope: Uniform radial-grid tests of isolated hydrogenic 1s, 2s, 2p and 3d states; not a direct general many-electron Schrödinger solver.

items.label: Stationary electronic Schrödinger equation
items.scope: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic many-body eigenproblem; add nuclear repulsion separately. Runnable examples cover only isolated one-electron hydrogenic atoms, not direct general many-electron solutions.

items.label: Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations
items.scope: Closed-shell RHF equations for occupied spatial orbitals generally include nonlocal exchange. Published examples cover the spherical 1s²-helium local reduction and fixed-input H₂ RHF using a separate molecular-integral implementation. Their bases, discretizations and references differ; inspect each input and validation record below. These examples do not validate general multicenter molecules, open shells or correlated methods.

items.label: Local Kohn–Sham DFT
items.scope: Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states.

items.label: Time-dependent Kohn–Sham equations
items.scope: Representative local time-dependent KS equations. Distinguish initial-state dependence, exchange-correlation memory and adiabatic approximations. No dedicated real-time or response implementation is published.

items.label: Two-dimensional rotational advection
items.scope: Prescribed divergence-free solid rotation only; not Euler fluid dynamics or arbitrary velocity fields.

items.label: Shallow-water equations with bed source

items.label: Forced incompressible flow and wall manufactured solutions

items.label: Level-set interface advection
items.scope: Prescribed2D rigid motions with analytic exterior data only. Normal-speed, curvature-driven and two-phase fluid equations are reading only.

items.label: Forced vorticity about a maintained shear layer
items.scope: Fixed periodic[0,2pi]² initial-growth case,delta.25,nu.005,epsilon1e-5,32²/64²/128²,T1. Compare an independent Fourier–Galerkin linear IVP and separate timestep/amplitude probes; no late roll-up certification.

items.label: Boussinesq vorticity with active buoyancy
items.scope: Periodic[0,2pi]²,nu=kappa.005,delta.25,epsilon1e-5,32²/64²/128²,T2. Smooth double-layer initial growth is compared with an independent linear reference; no RT-turbulence or sharp-density-interface claim.

items.label: ALE scalar conservation on moving cells
items.scope: Periodic unit interval,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x),N40/80/160,T1, plus constant-state GCL and fixed-N temporal refinement. Prescribed1D motion only; no Saltzman or general moving-mesh fluid claim.

items.label: Linear rotating shallow-water equations
items.scope: Periodic unit square,mode(1,2),height amplitude.01,N16/32/64,T.5, plus separate time refinement. No nonlinear shallow-water,spherical/global dynamics or Williamson test claim.

items.label: Variable-viscosity vector stress boundary-value problem
items.scope: Annulus1≤r≤2,zero Dirichlet on both circles,periodic theta,Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr. Separately check velocity,strain,physical traction,work and nonzero net boundary force. No Navier–Stokes or general-quadrilateral certification.

items.label: Special-relativistic ideal MHD (SRMHD)
items.scope: Nonlinear CP exact family rho=p=Bx=etaA1,gamma4/3,periodic unit interval,N64/128/256,one period. Check conserved means,phase,amplitude and stage physicality; no generic RMHD shocks,extreme magnetization/speeds or multidimensional divergence-control claim.

items.label: Discontinuous and full-tensor diffusion BVP
items.scope: Separate scalar harmonic-flux FV from full-tensor Q1 with nonzero cross terms. MG and AMG solve the same matrix.

items.label: Coulomb electrostatics with mixed periodic boundaries
items.scope: Neutral system,Coulomb constant1. Distinguish genuine2P references from finite-vacuum3P plus correction.

items.label: Electrostatic Vlasov–Poisson equations
items.scope: 1D1V electrons and fixed neutralizing background. Separate weighted full-f particle,mesh and time approximations from the linear-reference scope.

items.label: Hard-sphere Boltzmann transport,walls and reservoirs
items.scope: 1D space,3D velocity monatomic gas. Physical-time speed-dependent hard-sphere collisions,wall flux distributions and open reservoirs.

items.label: Static grey radiative transfer,scattering and linear exchange
items.scope: Use a normalized angular mean. Material exchange is evolved in the1997 transport example and periodic Fourier controls. The1997 optical coordinates give a unit exchange coefficient; physical-coordinate controls multiply both exchange terms by kappa.

items.label: Su–Olson1996 non-equilibrium diffusion and material exchange
items.scope: x=sqrt(3)kappa*z,distinct from x=kappa*z in1997 transport. Boundary data and references remain separate; non-unit-epsilon closed cells are separate controls.

items.label: Static grey M1 moments in flat spacetime
items.scope: c=1,2D space with full3D pressure including Pzz. Separate isotropic/vacuum branches,closed-PDE MMS and beam defects against angular transport; no relativistic-fluid claim.

items.label: Scalar Ito diffusion: GBM and OU
items.scope: Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system.

items.label: Gaussian probability measures: tails and correlated targets
items.scope: A probability-density/integration model. Separate ordinary importance weights/known-variance intervals and observable-specific2D Gaussian diagnostics; no physical-time or universal MCMC-convergence claim.

items.label: Finite-dimensional linear systems and factorizations
items.scope: Only the four specified direct matrices and two algebraic saddle sizes are covered. No general stability, scalability or PDE guarantee is implied.

items.label: Finite-dimensional matrix eigenproblems
items.scope: Explicitly restarted two-pass Arnoldi, one Ritz pair, restart lengths 8/16 and shifts none/0/950. No implicit restarting, Krylov-Schur, locking, clustered-spectrum or nonnormal extension is claimed.

items.label: Fixed-end string eigenvalues and consistent-mass FEM
items.scope: Unit length, tension and density; homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints at 0 and 1; the lowest three modes on 15/31/63 interior nodes. No 2D, variable-coefficient, nonlinear or time-evolution extension is claimed.

items.label: Linear Maxwell fields in vacuum and dielectrics
items.scope: The representative equations describe three-dimensional linear electromagnetics. This implementation is restricted to a z-invariant, genuinely two-dimensional Yee cylinder problem with Ez/Hx/Hy.

items.label: Passive Lorentz–Ohmic Maxwell fields
items.scope: A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

items.label: Finite-dimensional nonlinear maps, roots and differential actions

items.label: Centered spatial difference
items.scope: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions. Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode. Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics. Near-saturated Schnakenberg pattern: near-stationarity and grid/time convergence: Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual. Solve a Re100 lid-driven cavity and manufactured flow with a nonperiodic wall-bounded2D vorticity/streamfunction method. Compare original finite-grid Ghia tables, wall shear and grid refinement, keeping a separate pressure-Poisson/gradient manufactured problem distinct. Additional periodic2D KH/RT initial growth uses maintained smooth bases and independent linear IVPs; actual centered conservative face fluxes and Heun evolve vorticity/buoyancy with pressure eliminated. Additional2D cell-centered Poisson uses actual five-point face differences and half-cell Robin elimination; check Neumann compatibility/mean gauge and continuous boundary-flux error. Additional actual2D linear rotating-SWE C-grid uses staggered gradients/divergence and adjoint four-point Coriolis interpolation; separate continuous and discrete-symbol references.

items.label: Upwind finite differences
items.scope: The additional Zalesak-type example is two-dimensional scalar rotation in a prescribed divergence-free velocity. Compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL with the same periodic grid and SSPRK(3,3), measuring stage bounds, conservation and full-turn shape errors. It does not certify FCT or general multidimensional Euler bounds. Additional1D scalar transport on nonuniform moving cells uses actual upwind flux with positive physical-minus-face speed; not Euler fluid or remapping.

items.label: Lax–Friedrichs
items.scope: The additional double rarefaction connects one-dimensional conservative MUSCL, shared Lax–Friedrichs fluxes, mean-preserving positive-state scaling and SSPRK(3,3). Check the admissible CFL/wave-speed conditions, means and faces at each forward-Euler candidate/SSP stage, and conservation budgets; this does not certify general Euler, WENO, DG or MHD positivity.

items.label: Godunov-type finite volumes
items.scope: Check shallow-water bed sources and hydrostatic reconstruction with wet/emerged lakes and a SWASHES steady Bernoulli flow. A separate flat-bed Ritter dam break tests genuinely dry states, conservation budgets and a fixed-depth front.

The additional low-Mach vortex uses the same unlimited central primitive reconstruction for both Roe variants. It does not verify general limited MUSCL or a TVD guarantee. items.label: WENO5-JS
items.scope: Compare critical-point reconstruction from cell means using WENO-JS/Z power-two weights and actual periodic scalar transport. Separate epsilon choices, analytic cell means versus point values, and spatial error versus time-step effects.

items.label: Continuous P1 Galerkin FEM
items.scope: AdditionalP1 cases compare an Lshape singularity on uniform/matched-DOF graded meshes and square/warped triangles. Independently increase corner-Duffy quadrature and compare L2/H1 errors and mesh quality.

items.label: Rusanov / local Lax–Friedrichs flux
items.scope: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity. The additional2D Cartesian Noh edition updates both x/y fluxes and both momenta on a full square. The additional spherical Sedov blast measures grid and finite deposition-radius effects separately.

items.label: HLL
items.scope: Three-grid 2D Double Mach verification using HLL and Heun compares a separately written finite-grid numerical reference, boundary-flux budgets, shock position and unresolved near-wall structure. The additional forward-step example verifies actual 2D finite-volume flow with reflecting walls including the step faces. The additional Guderley example evolves a zero-upstream-pressure spherical converging shock only before collapse and compares a semi-analytic similarity reference. Check shallow-water bed sources and hydrostatic reconstruction with wet/emerged lakes and a SWASHES steady Bernoulli flow. Additional lightweight1D SRHD symmetric collision/SRMHD finite-amplitude CP wave use the shared full7-variable stress/induction,MUSCL-minmod,causalHLL±1,SSPRK33 and Z recovery; no generic Riemann,GR or extreme-speed claim.

items.label: Roe
items.scope: A fixed smooth 2D Euler isentropic vortex at background Mach numbers .1 and .01 compares ordinary Roe and Miczek-type dissipation-matrix preconditioning D=P⁻¹|PA|, with unlimited central primitive-variable MUSCL reconstruction for both. SSPRK(3,3) retains physical time and the acoustic CFL. Velocity error, dynamically normalized pressure error, periodic conservation and sampled Fourier diagnostics are evaluated separately. Pseudo-time or dual-time steady acceleration, slope limiting and TVD guarantees remain outside this example.

items.label: Minmod
items.scope: Minmod limits conserved-variable MUSCL slopes in this Noh edition's spherical series. Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant states. The additional Zalesak-type example is two-dimensional scalar rotation in a prescribed divergence-free velocity. Compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL with the same periodic grid and SSPRK(3,3), measuring stage bounds, conservation and full-turn shape errors. It does not certify FCT or general multidimensional Euler bounds.
